relatedNodes.html: Consistency plays a vital role in the survival of any kind of relationship. So make sure that the effort, time and attention you invested in her during the early stages of your relationship will endure rather than waver.

While financial security is an essential facet of any relationship, boasting about it and waving your wealth around like a banner is just flat-out off-putting. Colombian women will not stand for that level of boisterousness. Confidence is one thing, arrogance is another.

Given your cultural differences, misunderstandings and arguments are inevitably bound to arise. While overcoming this issue can be a major challenge for most couples, it doesn’t really have to be a relationship-ending problem.
